name: Brave
description: This Image contains a browser-accessible version of Brave.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  brave:
    container_name: big-bear-brave # Name of the Docker container
    image: kasmweb/brave:1.15.0-rolling@sha256:679eefbde9b44b6de2a73a5b266790393cea11e5756a8ab884798944cfef6ea7 # Docker image for the Brave browser
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:6901" # Expose port 6901 for VNC access
    environment:
      - VNC_PW=casaos # Set the VNC password to 'casaos'
      - LAUNCH_URL=https://community.bigbeartechworld.com/ # Set the default URL to Big Bear Tech World
    shm_size: 512m # Allocate 512 MB of shared memory
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/Downloads:/home/kasm-user/Downloads # Mount the host directory to the container's Downloads directory
